name: Open Frame

head.rule: Serif headings, sentence case. One italic accent word allowed.

wordmark.rule: Wordmark only. Outlined in logos/open-frame-wordmark*.svg so it renders without the font. TTFs in fonts/.

logo_rules: The mark is an open bracket frame with a 4-point spark inside. Always one color: ink on light, cream on dark. Never multicolor, never with shadows or effects. Use the mark on its own most of the time, and the wordmark sparingly: site header, end cards, documents.
color_rules: Mostly ink, white and cream with lots of whitespace. The four accents are only for accents and icons, cycled red, blue, yellow, green. Flat color, no drop shadows.
